fusions.name: Palmed and Flicked
fusions.desc: Flicks a palmed knife that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a target that has not been hurt yet, it has 30% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Unshaking Thrust
fusions.desc: A sure thrust that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckles White
fusions.desc: Increases your piercing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Fingers
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
